settings.heading: 1. What is VedicFolks?
settings.row_content: VedicFolks is a spiritual platform that connects devotees with experienced Vedic priests to perform authentic Vedic rituals, homams, and poojas based on traditional scriptures.

settings.heading: 2. How can I book a pooja or ritual?
settings.row_content: You can book a pooja directly through our website by selecting the desired ritual, filling in the required details, and completing the payment process.

settings.heading: 3. Who performs the poojas and rituals?
settings.row_content: All rituals are performed by qualified and experienced Vedic priests who follow traditional Vedic procedures and guidelines.

settings.heading: 4. Can I participate in the pooja online?
settings.row_content: Yes. Many rituals can be attended remotely through live video or updates so devotees can witness the ceremony from anywhere.

settings.heading: 5. Will I receive Prasadam after the pooja?
settings.row_content: Yes. After the completion of the ritual, the prasadam and sacred items may be shipped to your registered address whenever applicable.

settings.heading: 6. How do I know the pooja was performed?
settings.row_content: You may receive confirmation through photos, videos, or live streaming depending on the type of ritual you book.

settings.heading: 7. What payment methods are accepted?
settings.row_content: We accept secure online payments such as debit cards, credit cards, net banking, and other supported payment gateways.

settings.heading: 8. Can I change the pooja date after booking?
settings.row_content: In certain cases, the pooja date may be rescheduled if you contact our support team before the scheduled time.

settings.heading: 9. Do you provide consultation services?
settings.row_content: Yes. You can consult experienced astrologers and priests for spiritual guidance, astrology consultations, and remedies.

settings.heading: 10. How can I contact customer support?
settings.row_content: You can contact our support team through email, phone, or WhatsApp for assistance with bookings or any questions.

settings.heading: General Questions (FAQ)
settings.description: Helpful answers to guide you through our spiritual services.

settings.heading: What payment types do you offer?
settings.row_content: We accept Cash on Delivery, Debit card, Credit card, and Net banking for purchases

settings.heading: What is Cash on Delivery (COD)?
settings.row_content: Cash on Delivery (COD) is a payment method where you can pay the invoice amount in cash at your doorstep upon the actual delivery of your order. It’s an option available for those uncomfortable with online payments. Please note that COD payments are accepted only in Rupees.

settings.heading: How can I use a Gift Voucher/Promotional code on my order?
settings.row_content: After clicking ‘Checkout,’ enter your Gift Voucher/Promotional code. The valid amount/offer will apply automatically. Proceed to checkout, pay the remaining amount using your preferred payment method.”

settings.heading: Payment FAQ
How does the delivery process work?
settings.row_content: Our deliveries are handled by reputable couriers. Once your order is dispatched, you’ll receive an email containing the tracking number and courier company details. Use the tracking number on the courier company’s website to track your package.

settings.heading: What is your Online Return Policy?
settings.row_content: We value your feedback to enhance our service. While we strive for your complete satisfaction with our products and services, if you’re dissatisfied, please refer to our Returns and Refunds Policy for online returns.

settings.heading: How do I cancel my order?
settings.row_content: If you wish to cancel your order, you can do so by sending us an email on 91 94866 33869. You can also contact us on (Timings: 9:30 am-5 pm IST), within 24 hours of placing the order.

settings.heading: How will I get a refund for my cancelled orders and how long will this process take?
settings.row_content: Please refer to our Returns and Refunds Policy to understand if your order qualifies for a return. For pre-paid orders that have not yet been shipped, your order will be cancelled within 24 hours of your request and reflect as per your bank guidelines, which is usually within 10 business days. For all orders that have been delivered, we do not entertain return requests unless the order qualifies, as per our Returns and Refunds Policy. For any such requirements, please call us on 91 94866 33869 (Timings: 9:30 am-5 pm IST) Monday to Friday or email us .

settings.heading: By when can I expect delivery of my order?
settings.row_content: We aim to deliver your order promptly, but there might be delays due to movement restrictions. We appreciate your understanding and remain committed to delivering your order as soon as possible.

settings.heading: What if I receive an incomplete, incorrect or damaged order?
settings.row_content: We strive to ensure accurate and satisfactory order fulfilment. For any complaints about your order, please contact us within 7 business days of delivery for quick resolution. In the rare case of receiving a product with tampered or open packaging, kindly inform us within 2 business days of receipt, providing supporting images or videos if applicable, to assist us in addressing your concern effectively.
